description:
Package keyframe IDs, dHash/CLIP fingerprints, OCR snippets, and linked state-memory node IDs into an immutable, cryptographically hashable evidence pack for compliance and audit trails. Use create_evidence_pack instead of export_trajectories when generating tamper-proof cryptographic audit proofs for compliance rather than dumping training trajectories.

Returns cryptographic evidence pack with SHA-256 payload hash, keyframe fingerprints, and state-memory links.

keyframe_state_ids.description: Array of keyframe visual state IDs

linked_state_memory_nodes.description: State memory node IDs linked to this visual evidence pack

name: create_evidence_pack
